description: Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Issue the exact credential authorized by a human at https://weverlabs.com/verified-single/ after existing Wever email sign-in, a current photo and their own single-status attestation. POST /api/single-credential-issue. 0.10 USDC on Base via x402, under the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Replay the same authorization for the original result. Check status anonymously with wever_single-credential-check on /mcp-free.
